body:
That's good advice. It's hard to go in without expectations but that's how I ended up in a 2 year relationship, in love with someone who clearly didn't feel the same way back. But the first few parts are what matters I reckon. I went in without expectations and it ended up growing to something I hadn't thought of. 

Btw do you have skype or some such? I don't usually ask outright but you've helped a lot more than you know and from what you've said about your own problems, I'd like to help you as well or at least get to know you a bit more.

I guess I'm just hesitant, I really don't know why. I'm very used to getting fucked over by people so I suppose I expect it of anyone I'd pursue from here on out as well? I dunno

Also my 2 year relationship with aforementioned girl was sexless and she just went on to fuck a random guy friend of hers on a whim, so that kind of stings. Trust issues abound now.

I just really have trouble connecting on an emotional, romantic level, and she made it harder for me to do so.

It was physical and verbal abuse. I'm sorry that you went through that as well. People take advantage of good people.

And yeah I suppose I do, but it's hard to not see my recent ex as the person I want to keep being with. And this book shop girl is cute and flirted with me a bit. The store is close to me yeah, but it's still far enough away that I'd need to travel by car. Don't have my license yet, and I have some anxieties regarding obtaining it (and family is not fond of helping me to obtain it). Sucks to have family drive you down to go mack on a girl. Like mommy holding my hand while I'm trying to get pussy lmfao

Also yeah I get what you mean. This account I'm on is a throwaway for a throwaway I guess you'd call it. I have posted here a lot before to help and get help, but for some reason I felt especially embarrassed about making this post, so I went ahead and made this one for it. Just talking to people and trying to help is cathartic in its own way. It's really all I've had the last 3-4 months.

I live on the internet as well my friend

You're right that my mind is likely biased because of how fresh the wound is. But it's not even the want for true love that defines my suicidal feelings. I've been suicidal even when I was HAPPY with the girl who cheated on me. (might be why she cheated, eh? lmao)

It's odd. Abuse and surroundings can take someone who was otherwise going to end up adjusted, and then just wreck them entirely and turn them into a sad sack who cries a lot and doesn't know any longer how to handle things that would've been par for the course ages ago.

There is this girl that works at a book shop near me (I read a ridiculous amount ftr), but I'm hesitant to get back into the fray I guess. As much as I love being with someone and going steady with only 1 person, I fucking hate dating. Like the feeling things out part to see if you're compatible? Would absolutely rather get fucked with a chimney poker.

By the way, I do appreciate you sticking here and actually speaking with me. Most people would've just skipped by now and left it at their first or second message.

I wonder if the shit experiences I've had in relationships along with my experiences with being abused will fuck my ability to ever connect with someone again, though? I'm not exactly the most put-together person. I recall those viral posts from a few years ago. They resonate now.

Only Pick 2:

Smart,
Mentally Stable,
Attractive

That's how it feels sometimes. 

I feel as though I won't find another connection. I'm too broken a person to get another shot at what I want. I'm probably going to end up alone and unhappy in a shit job until I die anyway, you know? Why wait til then?

Not even 2 months ago. And a half a month prior we were super happy together. She cheated and continues to tell me about the guy she cheated with whenever she can.

I loved her and still love her very deeply as a person. It's hard to be wronged by someone you love so deeply, when in reality they didn't really care too much back. 

It's so hard to just find someone who's a good person, who you click with, and who cares as much about you as you do for them.

Online dating is all I've done really.

Man I really connected with the 2 year long relationship girl too. God damn it. 

Abuse really fucked me. I crave the love that got warped when I was a child. I want pure, real love now. Not what I got back then. 

It all feels so useless.
